시편 34:1.content: A Psalm of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the Lord at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

시편 34:2.content: My soul shall make her boast in the Lord: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

시편 34:3.content: O magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.

시편 34:4.content: I sought the Lord, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

시편 34:5.content: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

시편 34:6.content: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

시편 34:7.content: The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

시편 34:8.content: O taste and see that the Lord is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

시편 34:9.content: O fear the Lord, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

시편 34:10.content: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the Lord shall not want any good thing.

시편 34:11.content: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

시편 34:12.content: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?

시편 34:13.content: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

시편 34:14.content: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

시편 34:15.content: The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.

시편 34:16.content: The face of the Lord is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

시편 34:17.content: The righteous cry, and the Lord heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

시편 34:18.content: The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

시편 34:19.content: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the Lord delivereth him out of them all.

시편 34:20.content: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.

시편 34:21.content: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

시편 34:22.content: The Lord redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
